Chat UI

Source: R/chat.R
shad_chat_ui.Rd

The UI half of a streaming chat module: a stick-to-bottom transcript plus a composer (auto-sizing textarea + send button). Pair with shad_chat_server().

Usage

shad_chat_ui(
  id,
  placeholder = "Message...",
  height = "60vh",
  welcome = NULL,
  send_label = "Send"
)

Arguments

id

Module id.

placeholder

Composer placeholder text.

height

Transcript height (CSS unit).

welcome

Optional tags shown before the first message (empty state).

send_label

Accessible label for the send button.

Value

A chat UI tag.

See also

Other shadshiny chat: shad_chat_server()

Examples

if (interactive()) shad_chat_ui("chat", height = "60vh")
